renderContract.mediaPolicy: Preserve original color, aspect ratio, source speed, visible source watermarks and embedded text. New image plates are symbolic backgrounds, not evidence.
renderContract.motion: Deterministic absolute-time smooth motion. No random frame jitter, spring hunting or drum-triggered shake. Reading and screen content remain stable.
renderContract.characters: Reuse native Live2D only, subtle existing expressions/blinks/breathing; no new TTS, lip sync or music-driven mouth motion.
renderContract.output: Native preview only; no full-film video encoding or export.
